other_text: In the fall of 1993, Nancy Stevens was murdered. 23 years later, Kerri Stevens has nightmares that her fate will end up like her mother's. The most frightening thing about Kerri Stevens's nightmares is that she isn't dreaming...
moderation_notes: The poster hints at violent themes related to murder and nightmares.
description: A poster features a large axe and a white car against a dark background, with bold text reading "'93 del soul" and production credit.
